subject: GreenGlade activation: invoicing channel, SSO access & template questions
messages:
From: Oliver Grant <oliver@greenglade.co>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: accounts@greenglade.co
Date: Mon, 26 Jul 2027 08:32:00 +0100
Subject: Vendor activation and first invoices — channel & VAT handling

Hi Jordan,

Thanks for the onboarding checklist yesterday. We are getting GreenGlade ready to go live as a Redwood vendor next week and I wanted to confirm a couple of invoicing details so our AP team can prepare: 

1) Portal vs email: do you prefer we upload invoices through your vendor portal (we can SSO via our IdP) or send via email to accounts-payable@redwoodinference.com?

2) EU VAT / reverse charge: GreenGlade will submit invoices with VAT annotations. Any specific fields you require (VAT number location, seller/buyer annotations) in the invoice template?

3) Subject token / PO stamping: if we end up emailing invoices, is there a required subject token you parse? Also, will Redwood accept PO stamping on the PDF itself rather than in the subject line?

Attached: our completed onboarding_form (draft) and a sample invoice CSV export so you can see our default line-item formatting.

Appreciate a quick confirmation so we can train the AP team.

Best,
Oliver
Oliver Grant
Finance Ops, GreenGlade Technologies
Attachments: onboarding_form.xlsx (spreadsheet), sample_invoice.csv (csv)

From: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwoodinference.com>
To: Oliver Grant <oliver@greenglade.co>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwoodinference.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 26 Jul 2027 11:14:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Vendor activation and first invoices — channel & VAT handling

Hi Oliver — great to hear you’re close to go-live. Short answers first, then details/links:

- Preferred: portal (SSO) is strongly preferred — it gives faster ACKs and automatic PO matching.
- VAT: include the VAT registration number in the header (seller). For reverse-charge: add a note on the invoice body and include both buyer and seller VAT fields.
- Subject token: only required for email fallback. PO stamping on the PDF is acceptable but PO number must also be machine-readable (OCR-friendly) — either in header or filename.

Details / next steps:
1) Portal SSO: we support SAML 2.0. We’ll send an SP metadata URL. If you already have SSO set up with other vendors we can reuse the configuration — Vanessa (cc) will coordinate the technical handshake.
2) Invoice template: minimum fields we enforce for automatic processing:
   - Invoice number
   - Invoice date (ISO yyyy-mm-dd)
   - PO number (if applicable)
   - Line items with quantity, unit price, tax code, currency
   - Seller VAT number (header)
3) Email fallback: if you send to accounts-payable@redwoodinference.com include a subject token in the format: GG-INVOICE:PO=<PO_NUMBER>;V=1. Example subject: "GG-INVOICE:PO=12345;V=1". If no PO, use "GG-INVOICE:V=1;NOPO".

I’m attaching our onboarding form link (please confirm the legal entity mapped to your invoices) and a small sample CSV that our ingestion pipeline accepts. Monica will validate VAT formatting against EU rules.

Let us know a preferred time for a 20-min SSO handoff call — available tomorrow 10–12 PT.

Thanks,
Jordan Blake
Head of Procurement Operations
Redwood Inference
Attachments: link to onboarding form: https://drive.google.com/open?id=1a2B_onboarding_form_example, sample_invoice.csv (provided)

- For email fallback, our AP system would prefer putting PO in the subject line (we can template that). Can you confirm whether semi-colon separated key=value is strictly required?

From: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwoodinference.com>
To: Oliver Grant <oliver@greenglade.co>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwoodinference.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 26 Jul 2027 16:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Vendor activation and first invoices — channel & VAT handling

Hi Oliver — all good on SAML/Azure AD. For your two quick points: 

1) Subject token formatting: the parser expects key=value pairs delimited by semicolons. The PO key must be "PO" and the version key "V". We tolerate uppercase/lowercase but recommend the exact form to avoid edge cases. Example valid subjects:
   - GG-INVOICE:PO=98765;V=1
   - GG-INVOICE:V=1;NOPO

2) PO stamping: PDF-stamped PO is fine, but please ensure the PO is not an image-only stamp that OCR cannot read. We recommend adding the PO number to the PDF metadata or filename as well: e.g., "GG_PO_98765_invoice_20270726.pdf".

3) VAT notes: Monica ran your sample CSV — fields look acceptable but please move the seller VAT number to the top header row (we look for VAT_Number or VAT). Also include a line-item tax_code using EU reverse-charge value "RC" when applicable.

4) SSO handoff: Vanessa will propose a 20-min slot for the SAML exchange; she can take the Azure metadata you mentioned.

We’ll provision your vendor ID today so you can try a portal upload tomorrow. If you want to run one PDF through email fallback first, send to accounts-payable@redwoodinference.com with the subject token and cc onboarding@redwoodinference.com so Monica can watch the ingestion.

Best,
Jordan
Attachments: sample_subject_token.txt (example content), onboarding_form_link: https://app.redwood-inference.com/onboard/GG-2027-045
